what: Lee Sharks's rulings during the sweep, verbatim, with the deposits they govern.

rulings.ruling: the Robinson jeremy / vaughn conversation was - and i - a public facebook conversation, theres no way to deindex it, and its been published as a standalone drama like that since at least 2015 - nothing for it. and sally sandalsocks is a handle. those were all public conversations.

rulings.subject: helpdesk staff member named in #876 (OpenAIRE exchange)
rulings.ruling: a helpdesk staff member in their official capacity is not private. that is public correspondence.

rulings.subject: B0150 reader flag: #330 says Pearl claims the Good Gray Poet mantle, while #6, #1119 and #332 give it to The Secret Book of Walt
rulings.ruling: pearl does claim the mantle of the good grey poet directly. i claim this mantle of the good grey poet i claim this mantle: king of may. and the mantle object lays the bearing of that claim in secret book of walt - repairing that would not be a repair. careful.
rulings.effect: not a defect: Pearl (2014) makes the claim; the mantle object places its bearing in The Secret Book of Walt. No change to any of the four. Standing caution for the repair pass: reader flags of cross-deposit 'contradiction' are candidates, not defects; each is checked against the record and brought to Lee before anything is changed.

rulings.subject: scope of the repair pass
rulings.ruling: we're bot eliminating contradiction, here - we're repairing broken, missing, and mislabelled files / and citations and so on - but the scope has crept into things it shouldnt
rulings.effect: Repair scope: broken files (conversion damage, stripped tables/lists/formulas, truncation), missing content (empty bodies, absent sections or attachments), mislabelled files (wrong body under a title, wrong title/version/type label, wrong ORCID or creator field), and citations (wrong, truncated or placeholder DOIs and references). Out of scope: contradictions between or within deposits, chronology or dating disagreements in the prose, the deposits' own arguments and figures, section-numbering and ordering in the text, and superseded versions (allowed to stand). defects.json entries are reader observations; the repair pass takes only the in-scope classes.

rulings.subject: names in deliberately published writing
rulings.ruling: why are you using a rule about private correspondence to repeatedly rewrite things i have deliberately published with names? dont you dare back correct bekah - how did the rule become no names may appear in published writing?
rulings.effect: The initials rule governs private correspondence only. Names in writing Lee deliberately published stay as published. Every name-redaction item the launcher put on the repair list is withdrawn; nothing had been changed in alexanarch. 'bekah' in #1374 stays.

rulings.subject: what the 'haley to h' edit was
rulings.ruling: with Haley, that is my daughters given name. that is different. and i had initially published a cleaned version to zenodo that reduced to h. in the restoration, the pre-cleaned file was accidentally attached for a time.
rulings.effect: The 'h.' edit was not a general initials rule. It restored the version Lee had published (cleaned, reducing his daughter's name to h.) after the restoration had accidentally attached the pre-cleaned file. The repair standard is: the published text as Lee published it. Names in deliberately published writing stay; where a restoration seated an earlier or uncleaned file in place of the published one, the published one is restored.

rulings.subject: the student 'Maria' named in #132
rulings.ruling: maria could be anyone - i have had about 20 marias as students, and i asked her at the time and she wanted her first name attached to her own poe.
rulings.effect: No change: her first name stays on her own poem, with her consent at the time.
